metrics.readable@1(S): fraction of the 64 items whose bridge binding content[S].best == the truth of S (countries, all); derived-exact readout (P19) of the binding's write into the answer row
metrics.capital_in_cell: fraction whose bridge content[capitals].best == the answer (second hop already done in the cell)
metrics.entity_in_cell: fraction whose content[all].best is an entity token
metrics.first_appearance: first layer at which r0rest's content_lifetime strip on countries is 'C' when r0rest's best country is the true country
metrics.hop: native_delta = measured change of M = l(answer) - l(donor0 answer) when the bridge cell takes donor 0's V (stepped Run.set_cell, re-measured here and cross-checked against job2 GT.V.d0); direct_delta = (w_donor - w_native) . reader, w = sum over the group's heads of p[h,r0] W_o,h v[6,r0] at L20 with the native p and the native reader (exact, P19); indirect_share = 1 - direct/native
